name: dataset/services/__init__.py
summary: Package-level facade that aggregates and exposes DatasetService, FileService, and SchemaService through a unified public API
purpose: Simplifies imports for consumers of the dataset services layer by providing a single entry point, decoupling them from the internal module file structure and establishing a clean package-level public interface
responsibilities: Re-export service classes from internal submodules at the package level
Provide a unified public API for the dataset services module
Abstract internal file organization from external consumers
Enable simplified imports for upper-layer modules and dependency injection
inputs: Internal service classes from dataset_service, file_service, and schema_service modules
outputs: Exposed public service classes: DatasetService, FileService, SchemaService
architecture_notes: Implements a package-level Facade pattern to decouple consumers from internal module structure. Acts as a service gateway for the dataset domain, following Python's __init__.py public API convention. Promotes Dependency Inversion by allowing upper layers to depend on the package abstraction rather than concrete implementation modules. Centralizes service discovery and import management.
improvements: Define __all__ to explicitly declare the public interface and prevent namespace pollution
Add module-level docstring explaining the package's architectural role
Consider lazy imports if service classes have heavy initialization costs to improve startup time
Evaluate registering services in a central dependency injection container within __init__.py
Add type stubs or ensure re-exports preserve type information for static analysis
